semantic_priorities: Tenant renovations need landlord permission; owner structural/system-affecting renovations require advance notification. Do not merge these into a universal permission rule.
Landlord-entry exceptions still require attempted advance arrangement, not an invented unconditional written-consent test.
Separate rent-increase notice exception applies when lease already states increase terms and timing.
Repair notices: small14days,large6months; urgent repairs can proceed without notice. Repair-related termination/reduced rent still must be agreed with landlord.
Housing-company shares confer apartment control; do not depict ownership of the entire physical building.
Physical-property permit conditions and housing-share/joint-spouse exceptions must remain distinct. Generic globe avoids equating EU with EEA.
Exact archived tax rates: housing shares1.5percent,physical property3percent; both use debt-free-price base. No invented euro amount, exemption or legal update.
Hidden unknown defects differ from knowing nondisclosure. Serious purchase-affecting defect condition remains explicit.
